source: Pew Research Center. 2009. "Faith in Flux: Changes in Religious Affiliation in the U.S."
method: Population is respondents with a valid answer to q15, asked only of those who report a specific age at which they became their current religious identity (q14) - a subset of this 2,867-respondent recontact survey's switchers, skewed toward people who adopted CURREL past early childhood. q15 asks whether becoming CURREL was mostly their own decision or mostly decided by parents/family; don't know/refused excluded from the denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
decision_order: Mostly decided by parents or family
